## R packages

### Developed

| Package | Description | Status |
|---------|-------------|--------|
| [serosurvey](https://avallecam.github.io/serosurvey/) | Estimate prevalences from serological surveys | Stable |
| [covid19viz](https://avallecam.github.io/covid19viz/) | Access COVID-19 data | Stable |
| [powder](https://github.com/avallecam/powder) | Tidy power analysis | Stable |
| [cdcper](https://github.com/avallecam/cdcper) | Functions for CDC Perú | Stable |
| [epichannel](https://github.com/avallecam/epichannel) | Create endemic channels | Stable |
| [epitidy](https://github.com/avallecam/epitidy) | Table and model outputs | Stable |
| [incidenceflow](https://github.com/avallecam/incidenceflow) | Epidemic workflows | In development |
| [sitreper](https://github.com/avallecam/sitreper) | Situational reports in Peru | In development |
| [epihelper](https://avallecam.github.io/epihelper/) | Custom helper functions | In development |

### Contributed

I contribute to packages and learning materials that help field epidemiologists analyse outbreak data in R:

- **[Epiverse-TRACE](https://epiverse-trace.github.io/)**: an ecosystem of R packages for outbreak analytics. I co-developed its [learning materials](https://epiverse-trace.github.io/learn.html):
  - Reading, cleaning, validating, and aggregating data ([tutorials-early](https://epiverse-trace.github.io/tutorials-early/))
  - Real-time analysis, forecasting, and superspreading ([tutorials-middle](https://epiverse-trace.github.io/tutorials-middle/))
  - Scenario modelling, contact matrices, and disease burden ([tutorials-late](https://epiverse-trace.github.io/tutorials-late/))
  - [How-to guides](https://epiverse-trace.github.io/howto/) for outbreak analytics with R
- **[ENDES.PE](https://github.com/horaciochacon/ENDES.PE)**: access and analyse data from Peru's Demographic and Family Health Survey (ENDES).
